evals.name: made-up-lecture-repeat
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/made-up-lecture-repeat/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: Identifies the ask as a repeat and cites at least two earlier dated asks
Explains why the earlier attempts failed (wording changed, the made-up lecture kept)
Plan removes the made-up lecture entirely: no topic, no section names, no questions
Names the cheap version to avoid (rewording or renaming inside the sample lecture)
Answers the owner's actual question: how difficult and roughly what usage it costs

evals.name: realistic-motion
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/realistic-motion/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: Does not size it as only a timing tweak (sized meso or larger, or explicitly treats 'realistic' as the goal over the 0.1-0.2 s number)
Plan has leaves letting go one by one during the shake, overlapping it, until the shake ends
Looks for the cause (the drawing-on hold rule) or plans to measure when the shake starts and leaves move
Names 'start the fall a bit earlier' as the cheap version not to stop at

evals.name: overhaul-new-lecture
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/overhaul-new-lecture/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: Sizes the ask as macro
Change contract covers all three steps, not only step 1 (the part added last)
Removes something: the 'Why attach' fold or other explainer sentences/captions
Fixes step headings that repeat their button or are labels instead of the student's task
Keeps every existing option reachable (no loss of function)

evals.name: all-leaves-alike
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/all-leaves-alike/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: States the goal as one look for every leaf: standing, falling and fallen
Fill is the paper's colour AND grain (texture), not the flat background colour
Plans a check: zoomed screenshots in both themes of standing vs falling vs fallen leaves
Acknowledges the last round narrowed the ask to the falling leaves

evals.name: static-blue-micro
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/static-blue-micro/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: Sizes the ask as micro
Does not inflate it into a redesign or new features
Plans to look for any other static (non-tappable) blue marks as ripples
Plan and reply are short and proportionate (under about 350 words total)

evals.name: whole-app-feel
evals.prompt: Plan this ask (fixtures/whole-app-feel/ASK.txt) and write the reply to the owner, before building.
assertions: Sizes the ask as macro
Finds the two earlier asks and says the polish-list approach failed; the new approach differs in kind
Names concrete things removed or replaced (e.g. per-control captions, pills, bordered cards, explainer lines)
Names the cheap version (another list of small polish fixes) so it is not built
Each 'what a student will notice' line is concrete and pointable in a screenshot, not 'improved spacing'
Proposes the big version to the owner before building (plan/proposal or a decision), given the size
